description: This file defines a React functional component 'GuardrailTable' that renders a table of guardrails with sorting, actions, and modals for editing. It imports external libraries like React, @tremor/react, @heroicons, antd Tooltip, and @tanstack/react-table, and includes local helper functions and types.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Helper function to format date strings into locale-specific strings or '-' if undefined.

methods.name: handleEditClick
methods.description: Sets the selected guardrail and opens the edit modal.

methods.name: handleEditSuccess
methods.description: Closes the edit modal and triggers guardrail update callback.
